SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-05-2019 - CONTINUED FOR ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE TO NOV-12-2019 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF JOHN SHEK IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT HERMIA WAZNER IS PRESENT ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED INTERPRETER DOROTHY WONG. HONORABLE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II HAD THE COURT CALL MARY PARYNO CASE WORKER OF JUDITH SHEK. MS PARYNO INFORMED THE COURT THAT THE NURSING HOME TEAM AND THE FAMILY WOULD BE MEETING REGARDING THE WELL BEING OF JUDITH. MS. PARYNO WILL CALL THE COURT AT 11:15AM TO GIVE THE JUDGE ADDITIONAL INFORMATION PER JUDGE ROBERTSON'S ORDER. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: CONTINUANCE VIA PHONE FOR ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE.(SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)
ORDER CASE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS.)

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCE REQUIRED AT THIS HEARING. NO APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCES BY DEFENDANT. HONORABLE A. JAMES ROBERTSON RECEIVED ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE FROM THE NURSING HOME AS PREVIOULY ARRANGED BY THE PARTIES IN THIS MATTER. MR. SHEK AT THIS TIME HAS NOT SUSTAINED HIS BURDEN TO SHOW MONETARY DAMAGES CAUSED BY DEFENDANT. ACCORDINGLY, THE COURT DISMISSES THE CASE WITHOUT PREJUDICE. MR. SHEK MAY REFILE THE CASE IF HIS SISTER IS NO LONGER UNDER THE CARE OF THE NURSING CENTER. JUDGE: A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(506)
